app.name: way1ong Survival
app.tagline: How not to get lost in the forests and mountains of Europe. Every piece of advice comes from an official source, named under the advice.

update.ready: A new version of the app is out.

sections.title: Sections
sections.dangers: What is dangerous and what is not
sections.orientation: Where am I, which way to go

section.soon: This section is being prepared. The advice will appear here once each piece has been checked against its official source.

install.title: On your phone or computer
install.text: The program can be installed like an app: it gets its own icon and opens without internet.
install.ios: On iPhone and iPad: tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”. The program gets its own icon and opens without internet.

about.title: About
about.text: A free program by way1ong: no ads, no tracking, no account. It sends nothing over the network; the chosen language and country are kept only on this device.
about.rule: Every piece of advice comes only from an official source that allows such use. Under each piece of advice: its source, when the method works, how reliable it is and where people go wrong.
about.series: the pages of the countries with emergency numbers, read on {date}

notices.notDoctor: This is not a substitute for a doctor.
notices.usArmy: Based on a U.S. Army manual.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.eu: 112 is the European emergency phone number, available everywhere in the EU, free of charge. 112 functions alongside existing national emergency numbers.
emergency.pickText: Choose a country, and the app shows its emergency numbers. The choice is kept only on this device.

services.deaf: for deaf and hard of hearing people (SMS, chat, video and fax)
